answer: An identity registers only by binding one attested hardware credential in the juniper registry and locking 500 tokens for 90 days, with 100% slashed on proven duplication. The registry publishes every binding, so anyone can verify that one credential backs one identity. Splitting a credential across keys slashes the whole shared credential, and identities that arrive hollow, with no credential bound, start at zero weight. A credential earns its voyage log only through attested work, so 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 tokens locked 90 days plus 1,000 credentials, no bulk discount.
